interpretation: M1 assumes locked small signal; cold acquisition near rail is not equivalent to a steady locked measurement. This does not establish an error in the M1 frequency formula.
known_limitations: two resolutions and finite windows are not proof of eventual noncapture
summary-only source gives no complete raw trajectory
recommended_calibration_action: Do not fit frequency residual on unacquired cases. Establish capture protocol and trajectory evidence first; version any future dynamic model separately.
prediction_error: retained in parent and follow-up records; not treated as same-protocol model residual
